APPENDIX B. Economic comparison of the re-liquefaction process and the venting case

    Fig.B. 1 compared the CPT between the worst re-liquefaction cases (Case 1-1, 2-1) and case where all BOG was vented while paying the carbon tax.
At 6.5 bar storage pressure, venting case became more expensive than re-liquefaction case if the carbon tax exceeded 150 USD/tonCO2. At 15 bar
storage pressure, venting case became more expensive when the carbon tax exceeded 100 USD/tonCO2. Considering the carbon tax of 150 USD/tonCO2
in this study, all re-liquefaction processes are shown to be more economical compared to the case of venting CO2 BOG.
